input: Sign up for a community beekeeping taster day

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Beekeeping taster days are location-dependent — knowing the user's city or region determines which events and organisations are actually available to them.
The user may have a specific window of availability, which narrows down which upcoming events are viable options.
Taster days range from free community events to paid courses; knowing budget limits rules in or out certain options.
If the user is signing up solo vs. with others (e.g. a partner, friend, child), this affects the number of spots needed and whether family-friendly sessions matter.
The user may already have a specific provider or event in mind, or they may need help finding one from scratch — this changes whether the task is research-heavy or just registration.
Understanding what the user hopes to get out of the day (casual curiosity vs. deciding whether to take up beekeeping seriously) shapes which type of event is the best fit.
Knowing how the user prefers to register — online form, phone call, email — and whether they need any accessibility or dietary considerations flags practical next steps.
